zh.sourceText: 某市实验中学宣布，禁止学生携带智能手机进入校园，新规从下学期开学起执行。校长在说明会上解释：课堂上少了手机提示音和偷偷刷屏，任课老师普遍反映学生注意力明显更集中。同时，该校心理辅导室的记录显示，涉及网络欺凌的投诉比去年同期下降了四成。校门口，某儿童手机品牌趁机投放广告：『孩子成长的关键期，值得拥有更精彩的数字世界！』也有学生代表提出，手机里的学习类 App 是查资料的重要工具，一刀切并不合理。

textRefs.conclusion_1: 禁止学生携带智能手机进入校园
textRefs.reason_1: 课堂上少了手机提示音和偷偷刷屏，任课老师普遍反映学生注意力明显更集中
textRefs.reason_2: 该校心理辅导室的记录显示，涉及网络欺凌的投诉比去年同期下降了四成
textRefs.distractor_1: 孩子成长的关键期，值得拥有更精彩的数字世界
textRefs.distractor_2: 手机里的学习类 App 是查资料的重要工具，一刀切并不合理

hints: 结论在开头：学校宣布的新规是什么？
两个理由分别来自『课堂专注』和『心理辅导室记录』
校门口的广告在卖手机，学生的质疑在反对新规——谁在支撑结论？
zh.explanation: 结论是「禁止学生携带智能手机进入校园」。理由一：课堂上少了手机干扰，老师反映注意力更集中；理由二：网络欺凌投诉下降四成。「值得拥有数字世界」是儿童手机品牌的广告，借新规话题卖货；「App 是查资料工具、一刀切不合理」是学生的反对意见。找理由时要问：这句话是在支持这项规定，还是在趁机卖东西或唱反调？

en.sourceText: A city experimental middle school announced it will ban students from bringing smartphones onto campus, effective next semester. The principal explained at a briefing: with fewer notification sounds and fewer students secretly scrolling in class, teachers generally report that students are noticeably more focused. At the same time, records from the school counseling office show that complaints about cyberbullying fell by forty percent compared with the same period last year. Outside the school gate, a children's phone brand seized the moment with an ad: 'These crucial growing years deserve a more wonderful digital world!' Some student representatives also argued that educational apps on phones are important research tools, so an outright ban is unreasonable.

textRefs.conclusion_1: ban students from bringing smartphones onto campus
textRefs.reason_1: with fewer notification sounds and fewer students secretly scrolling in class, teachers generally report that students are noticeably more focused
textRefs.reason_2: complaints about cyberbullying fell by forty percent compared with the same period last year
textRefs.distractor_1: These crucial growing years deserve a more wonderful digital world
textRefs.distractor_2: educational apps on phones are important research tools, so an outright ban is unreasonable

hints: The conclusion is at the start: what rule did the school announce?
The two reasons come from 'classroom focus' and 'counseling office records'
The ad at the gate sells phones and the students' objection challenges the ban — which supports the conclusion?
en.explanation: The conclusion is 'ban students from bringing smartphones onto campus'. Reason one: with less phone distraction in class, teachers report better focus. Reason two: cyberbullying complaints fell by forty percent. 'Deserve a more wonderful digital world' is a phone brand's ad cashing in on the topic; 'educational apps are important tools, so an outright ban is unreasonable' is the students' objection. When hunting for reasons, ask: does this sentence support the rule, sell something, or push back against it?
